messages:
Mina (sec): Quick sync — proposing a 'BYOK trustzone' RBAC tier to isolate customer-managed HSM keys in the control plane. Goal: separate metadata/read-only ops from crypto ops. Need input on audit logging path, KMS integration, and incident runbook changes. @Alex @Chris @Maria ?
Alex (eng-platform): Quick q: do we proxy all crypto ops through an HSM-proxy (so key material never leaves HSM) or support delegated signing (ephemeral keys) outside the HSM? If proxy, how should we present key references to customers without leaking provenance? For KMS integration, we could forward events to a customer's KMS audit endpoint — is that wanted?
Chris (eng-ml): From inference side: proxying every sign adds ~8–12ms headroom in our p50/p95. We can tolerate some, but not if it multiplies with batching. Suggest a short-lived attestation token that allows local signing for TTL (e.g., 30s) and log issuance. Need threat model doc for that.
Dena (platform): Draft RBAC roles proposal so we can map cleanly to service accounts and SSO groups:
```
roles:
  - byok.trustzone.read_metadata    # list keys, view owner/region
  - byok.trustzone.crypto_sign      # request crypto ops proxied to HSM
  - byok.trustzone.admin_rotate     # rotate / rewrap ops, HIGH privilege
```
Also proposing new audit index: `audit.byok.trustzone` (Splunk/ELK) and a masking pipeline to pseudonymize key refs before cross-region shipping.
Mina (sec): Good start. Compliance constraints: some financial customers need 7-year retention. EU customers: avoid cross-border logs that contain any persistent key identifiers. Maria, can you confirm acceptable level of metadata?
Maria (compliance): Confirming constraints: key material must NEVER be exported. You MAY ship event metadata (operation, timestamp, result) but strip or pseudonymize persistent key IDs when leaving the EEA. Recommended approach: replace key_id with a region-specific salted hash (salt stored per-region, rotated annually). Also record KMS/HSM attestation chain into secure long-term archive for 5 years for audited customers. Need explicit customer opt-in to forward any identifiable key metadata to third-party endpoints.
Chris (eng-ml): OK — for attestation-token flow: we'll issue ephemeral token from HSM-proxy, allow local signers to use token until expiry. Log issuance event with pseudonymized token ID and TTL. Add perf test to ensure p95 remains under SLA when token cache hot.
Dena (platform): I'll add masking step in the log-forwarder. Pseudonymization pipeline idea:
- ingest raw event -> redact key_blob/key_material -> replace key_id with hashed_id(region_salt) -> write to `audit.byok.trustzone` index -> forward aggregated events to customer endpoints (only allowed with consent).
hsm-bot: INFO 2026-04-01T12:45:12Z - HSM proxy v2.3 deployed to staging (flags: --trustzone-mode)
Dena (platform): I'll open a PR with RBAC mappings + logship changes and masking script. Link: https://git.internal/repos/redwood/byok-ops/pulls/42 (draft).
Alex (eng-platform): One more: incident playbook update. If HSM-proxy goes unhealthy we CANNOT failover to external signing for BYOK (customers explicitly require no key export). Fallback must be: degrade to read-only + alert oncall + notify customer with ETA. Mina, can you draft playbook steps for detect/mitigate/escalate?
Mina (sec): On it. Action items captured: Dena -> PR for RBAC & masking; Maria -> compliance sign-off on pseudonymization approach & retention; Chris -> perf/regression test for token cache + attestation TTL; Alex -> update KMS-forwarder design to support per-region salted hashes and consent flags. Aim for canary next week. :calendar: 
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary window scheduled: 2026-04-08 02:00–06:00 UTC. Rolling deploy, will monitor `audit.byok.trustzone` index for masking failures.
Mina (sec): Thanks — please add any unanswered questions as comments on Dena's PR. :thumbsup:
